text:
rachel_p: quick sync — incoming customer asks from AcmeHealth + FinCorp. They want OptKit improvements. Options: 1) batching & smarter sequence packing, 2) quantization profiles (8-bit/4-bit), 3) prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts. Need to pick order for next sprint. use RICE lens? impact vs effort? any strong takes? @leo_dev @anya_ml @sam_infra
leo_dev: my vote is batching first. Biggest win on cost/latency for our hosted customers. effort = medium, risk = low. impact high for PLG metrics. batching can be rolled out gradually with feature flags.
anya_ml: quantization gives huge unit-cost wins but is noisy for some LLMs — QA failure modes and eval regressions need an eval harness. effort = high (eval + per-model tuning), impact = high if we can ship stable defaults.
sam_infra: caching (KV/prefix) is deceptively subtle. Works great for conversational reuse, low infra effort for the basic prefix cache, but billing/consistency rules and eviction policies add product complexity. effort = low-med, impact = medium-high for chat-heavy customers.
jamal_pe: from customer-asks: AcmeHealth cares about latency for high-concurrency flows (batching helps). FinCorp cares about cost predictability (quantization). So signals point split.
leo_dev: suggestion: do batching improvements first (fast wins), ship a simple prefix cache MVP in parallel (low risk), and start a focused quantization spike with 1-2 models + canary evals. That sequences low-risk -> medium -> high.
anya_ml: agree on spike approach for quant; set success criteria up front: <1% eval regression on our prompt suite and <30% latency increase on tail. Otherwise hold.
jamal_pe: propose launch criteria per feature: batching = measurable latency p50/p95 improvement vs baseline and no regression in correctness tests; cache = TTL and privacy docs; quant = eval pass + rollout plan + telemetry hooks.
ops-bot: reminder: canary window available next Wed 03:00-07:00 UTC for infra changes.
rachel_p: solid — aligns with RICE: batching (reach=high, impact=high, confidence=high, effort=mid) => top priority. cache MVP alongside batching. quant = runway item after a gated spike. I'll write a short PRD with RICE numbers + acceptance criteria and tag owners.
leo_dev: +1. I'll scope batching tickets and include perf benchmarks.
anya_ml: I'll own the quant spike and set up eval harness.
sam_infra: I'll add cache config + rollout plan and infra telemetry.
rachel_p: thanks all. quick poll: thumbs up if you agree with the sequencing (batching -> cache MVP -> quant spike).
leo_dev: :thumbsup:
anya_ml: :thumbsup:
sam_infra: :thumbsup:
jamal_pe: :thumbsup:
rachel_p: cool — I'll drop PRD by EOD and schedule a 30m triage tomorrow.
